term: empirical contingency and change in Kant’s Fourth Antinomy
definition: A state follows an opposed state in time and has an empirical condition; the time-indexed state in the change countermodel has this succession alone. It does not assert that the earlier state could have been absent at that same time. CPR A458–460/B486–488 is the source context.
note: Analyst’s explicit reconstruction for the Kant inquiry (#250), not an assertion that the surrogate exhausts the historical concept. Source fidelity and the missing philosophical bridges are discussed in docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md.
